releaseNotes: Much smaller app: the download drops from about 30-50MB to about 7MB. The VLC player engine (24MB, only needed for a few unusual streams and Dolby Vision channels) is no longer bundled - it downloads automatically the first time it is needed, or when you pick VLC under Settings > Player engine. Until it is installed, playback uses ExoPlayer. New: in Live TV and the TV Guide, pressing Down on the last category jumps back to the top of the list instead of stopping at the bottom. Includes the earlier provider-connection fixes, poster fallback, voice search and My List focus fixes.
